practiceQuestions.prompt: Cervical stretch promotes release of which hormone that reinforces uterine contractions?
Stronger contractions cause more cervical stretch, which promotes further contractions. What kind of feedback is this?
Which distinction between two lactation hormones is correct?
options: Both hormones act only by stopping lactation
Both hormones are made by the ovary
Prolactin ejects milk; oxytocin makes milk
Prolactin supports milk production; oxytocin supports milk ejection

practiceQuestions.prompt: Which term matches this description? The process of labour and birth.
Which term matches this description? Widening of the cervix during labour.
Which term matches this description? A hormone made in the hypothalamus and released by the posterior pituitary that supports uterine contractions and milk ejection.
Which term matches this description? A response that reinforces the initiating change.
Which term matches this description? Milk production and secretion by the mammary glands.
Which term matches this description? An anterior-pituitary hormone that stimulates milk production.
Which term matches this description? Movement of milk toward the nipple through contraction of cells around mammary secretory structures.
Which term matches this description? A neural and hormonal response initiated by sensory stimulation during feeding.

options: Ejection does not mean new milk has just been synthesized.
